If you have played our games before, you know that HFTGames usually specializes in over-the-top, fun and funny erotic adventures and stories. Our main sexy stars are frequently found shouting some very naughty things at the top of their lungs, as they experience the throws of ecstasy.

For Angel's Awakening, we wanted to do something a little different. For the tone and theme of Angel's Awakening, we choose to go for more realistic erotica than many of our other titles. What does this mean? It primarily means that during the sexy scenes in this story, you will find the erotic audio accompaniment to be more subdued and realistic. 

For example, as our main character Angela is having her first sexual experience with a woman, you will be treated to an almost ASMR like symphony of deep, ragged breaths, sharp inhales, quivering voices, deep, breathy moans and any number of other tantalizing, stimulating and realistic erotic sounds.

Overall, Angel's Awakening is a more serious, more intense and realistic erotic story than those we have produced before, and we hope you will find it just as titilating and satisfying as we do.

And have no fear, in our upcoming games we fully intend to return the silly, happy, over-the-top naughty fun of Wanderlust and Lilly Knight, with our upcoming title "Penny Patty Piper in Space" now in development.

As always, stay tuned and look out for Angel's Awakening this Friday.
